notes: Referral-code validity is signaled only by the input border turning red or green via the field-invalid and field-valid classes, with no text, icon, or message accompanying the state. Section 2.4 fires on meaning carried by color alone: a user who cannot perceive the red or green gets no signal whether the value is accepted. The field is labeled and operable, so no section 5 blocker applies; per section 1.7 this is a WCAG use-of-color failure with a workaround, making HIGH correct. The barrier is unambiguous.
